title: fix(account): send no-store cache headers on all account routes
author: TRDEFI
pr_body_excerpt:
﻿Closes #13771

Adds one middleware on `accountRoutes` (right after the auth middleware) that sets `Cache-Control: private, no-store, max-age=0` and `Pragma: no-cache` on every response, including the nested `/agents` and `/my-models` routes. Headers are set after `await next()` so nothing a handler does can skip the policy.

Also drops the per-handler `Cache-Control` line in the `/keys` list handler, since the router-level middleware now covers it.

A focused test covers one top-level response (`/account/profile`) and one nested response (`/account/agents`) for both headers.

gist.headline: The account pages forget
gist.blurb: Account routes now carry a firm little reminder not to linger in browser caches. Polli put the privacy labels on every drawer, including the nested ones.
gist.summary: Added router-level `Cache-Control: private, no-store, max-age=0` and `Pragma: no-cache` headers to every authenticated account response, including nested `/account/agents` and `/account/my-models` routes.
gist.impact: Account profile, agent, model, and key responses now consistently avoid browser or intermediary caching, with the policy applied after handlers complete so individual routes cannot bypass it.
gist.visual_concept: Depict account data as cozy labeled filing drawers beside a retro terminal, each stamped with a clear pixel-art “NO STORE” privacy tag. Polli, wearing a tiny archivist visor, carefully seals the drawers while a few code-plants grow nearby; the metaphor is that every account route, including nested drawers, receives the same protective cache policy.
